title: 第 2156 章 封印碎片九十九次锤炼本源异象圆满第 2155 章 诡异消亡大半的归墟虚影
slug: 儒道至上我在异界背唐诗
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：儒道至上？我在异界背唐诗！
第一卷：默认第2156章封印碎片，九十九次锤炼，本源异象圆满（..la）变故突生，全场诸圣脸色齐齐剧变，心神骤然紧绷，无数圣道法理瞬间运转，欲要出手驰援、护下洛神。
可众人动作终究慢了一瞬。
未待诸圣出手，墨瑶足下流淌的洛河之水骤然灵动翻腾，万千澄澈水纹破空飞出，化作一道横贯虚空的莹白水幕，不带半分杀伐戾气，却自带先天洛水镇邪封寂的无上道韵。
看似温柔婉转的洛水，撞上霸道无解的仙帝寂灭虚影刹那，瞬间爆发出极致的克制伟力。
漆黑暴戾的寂灭道力遇水即溃、逢泽即消，那尊足以碾压诸天顶尖大能的仙帝虚影，连一声嘶吼都未曾发出，躯体便寸寸消融、尽数瓦解。
瞬息之间，滔天虚影彻底覆灭，唯独虚空之中，残留着一缕细如发丝、坚韧至极的纯黑细线，悠悠飘荡，潜藏着归墟本源最核心的不灭根基。
墨瑶眸光沉静，抬手轻引，漫天洛水微光尽数收拢，温柔包裹住那缕漆黑细线，层层水纹交错封印、层层天道法理禁锢，将这缕不灭本源牢牢困住，稳稳托于白皙掌心。
她垂眸凝视掌心流转的黑丝，神色愈发郑重，对着一众心有余悸的诸圣缓缓道出万古隐秘的破局关键：“诸位可见？这便是归墟浩劫的真正恐怖之处。
归墟本源超脱天道，不死不灭、无生无死，诸天任何杀伐之力，都无法将其彻底抹除。”
“我等斩杀虚影，看似肃清祸患，实则只是击碎其表层法理，核心本源残丝始终留存虚空。
且每一次破灭重生、每一次杀伐淬炼，都会让其逐步滋生灵智、进化道途。”
“故而，往后对敌，不可只求斩杀灭敌，需做到斩灭形体、即刻封印本源残丝。
唯有如此，方能逐步肃清域外隐患，杜绝归墟彻底成型。”
圣人秘境之中，随着第七道仙脉彻底复苏、万古封禁尽数消解，整方天地彻底褪去了千万年的荒芜寂寥与残破颓态。
曾经岩层裸露、草木凋零的破败大地，在浩瀚无垠的时空仙泽与道初法理的层层滋养下，悄然焕发勃勃生机。
干裂的地脉涌出温润灵泉，顺着沟壑溪流蜿蜒流淌；荒芜崖壁破土生出青葱灵草、千年古木，枯木逢春、抽枝吐绿。
凝滞万古的天地灵气重新奔腾流转，氤氲仙雾覆满千山万壑，往日死寂清冷的秘境，此刻风含道韵、水藏天机，鸟语虫鸣此起彼伏，处处皆是生生不息的盎然气象，重回上古鼎盛盛景。
断崖之巅，词宋盘膝稳坐青石之上，周身仙光萦绕、法理流转不息。
自借仙脉福泽淬炼脊背龙骨以来，他已然沉心静气，完成了整整九十九轮极致缜密的道初法则打磨锤炼。

九十九轮淬炼，层层剥洗法理滞涩，步步打磨道韵本源。
每一轮锤炼，他都将脊背二十四节龙骨之中的道初法则细细梳理、规整、熔铸，剔除所有运转瑕疵，补齐每一处掌控短板，让原本刻意牵引的法理流转，渐渐融入肉身本能、契合大道本心。

Volume 1: Default Chapter 2156 Seal fragments, ninety-nine times of tempering, the original vision is perfect (..la) An unexpected change occurred, the faces of all the saints in the audience changed drastically, their minds suddenly became tense, and countless holy principles and laws were running instantly, wanting to rush to help and protect Luo Shen.
But everyone's movements were finally slow for a moment.
Before the saints could take action, the water of the Luo River flowing under Mo Yao's feet suddenly started to churn. Thousands of clear water patterns flew out of the air, turning into a curtain of crystal-white water across the void. It did not carry any murderous and violent aura, but it carried the supreme Taoist charm of the innate Luo River to suppress evil and seal silence.
Luo Shui, who seemed to be gentle and gentle, suddenly burst out with extreme restraint and power when he bumped into the overbearing and invincible Immortal Emperor's Nirvana Shadow.
The dark and violent power of Nirvana collapsed when it encountered water and disappeared when it encountered water. The phantom of the Immortal Emperor, who could crush the top powers in the heavens, did not even let out a roar, and his body melted and disintegrated inch by inch.
In an instant, the monstrous shadow was completely destroyed, leaving only a pure black thread as thin as hair and extremely tough, floating leisurely in the void, hiding the core of the immortal foundation of Guixu's origin.
Mo Yao's eyes were calm, and he raised his hand to guide it gently. All the glimmers of Luoshui in the sky were collected, and he gently wrapped the thin black thread. The layers of water patterns intertwined with seals, and the layers of heavenly laws were restrained. This strand of immortal origin was firmly trapped and held firmly in the palm of his white palm.
She lowered her eyes and stared at the black thread flowing in the palm of her hand, her expression became more solemn, and she slowly told the horrified saints the secret key to breaking the situation: "You can see? This is the real horror of the Guixu catastrophe.
The origin of Gui Xu is transcendent from the way of heaven. It is immortal and has no birth or death. No killing power from the heavens can completely erase it. "
"We kill the phantom, which seems to eliminate the disaster, but in fact we only shatter its superficial legal principles, and the remaining threads of the core origin remain in the void.
And every time it is destroyed and reborn, every time it is tempered by killing, it will gradually breed spiritual wisdom and the path of evolution. "
"Therefore, when facing the enemy in the future, we should not just kill the enemy, we must kill the body and immediately seal the remaining threads of the origin.
Only in this way can we gradually eliminate hidden dangers outside the territory and prevent the return of ruins from being completely formed. "
In the Saint's Secret Realm, as the seventh immortal vein was completely revived and all the eternal bans were lifted, the entire world had completely faded away from the desolation, loneliness and dilapidation that had characterized it for thousands of years.
The dilapidated land that once had exposed rock formations and withered vegetation has quietly become full of vitality under the nourishment of the vast expanse of time and space and the Daochu Dharma.
Warm spiritual springs gush out from the cracked earth veins, meandering along the ravines and streams; green spiritual grass and thousand-year-old trees emerge from the desolate cliffs, and dead trees sprout green branches in spring.
The spiritual energy of heaven and earth that had been stagnated for eternity is flowing again, and the dense fairy mist covers thousands of mountains and valleys. The secret realm that used to be dead and cold is now filled with Taoist charms in the wind, the secrets of heaven are hidden in the water, and the chirping of birds and insects is heard one after another. There is an endless atmosphere of life and prosperity everywhere, returning to the heyday of ancient times.
On the top of the cliff, Ci Song sat cross-legged on the bluestone, surrounded by fairy light and endless circulation of Dharma principles.
Ever since he used the blessings of the Immortal Vein to temper the keel on his back, he had become calm and composed and completed ninety-nine rounds of the extremely meticulous Daochu Law.
Ninety-nine rounds of tempering, peeling away the stagnant principles of the Dharma step by step, polishing the origin of Taoism step by step.
With each round of tempering, he carefully sorted out, organized, and forged the Dao Beginning Principles in the twenty-four keel bones on his back, eliminating all operational flaws, filling in every control shortcoming, and allowing the originally deliberately drawn Dharma principles to flow, gradually integrate into the instinct of the physical body, and conform to the true heart of the Dao.
